text: 今天（13日），中国人民银行公示，批准威士公司（VISA在我国境内成立的企业法人，为外商投资企业）筹备银行卡清算机构。获批筹备意味着什么？很多人看到消息会以为Visa马上就能在国内做人民币银行卡业务，其实不是这么简单。这次获批，只是拿到“筹备资格”，不等于可以直接开展业务。拿到筹备资格后，按照监管要求，威士公司需要在1年之内完成全部筹备工作，准备妥当后，再提交开业申请。这份申请需要央行和国家金融监管总局共同审核，审核通过，下发银行卡清算业务许可证，才算拿到正式许可。在拿到最终许可证之前，Visa不能在境内发行Visa品牌人民币银行卡，也无法为境内主体提供
text_en: Today (the 13th), the People's Bank of China announced that it has approved Visa Inc. (a corporate legal person established in China by Visa, as a foreign-invested enterprise) to prepare a bank card clearing institution. What does approval to prepare mean? Many people seeing the news may think Visa will soon be able to conduct RMB bank card business in China, but it is actually not that simple. This approval only grants "preparation qualification" and does not mean it can directly conduct business. After obtaining preparation qualification, in accordance with regulatory requirements, Visa Inc. must complete all preparatory work within one year, and after preparations are complete, submit an application to commence operations. This application must be reviewed jointly by the PBOC and the National Financial Regulatory Administration, and only after approval is granted and a bank card clearing business license is issued will it have obtained formal permission. Before obtaining the final license, Visa cannot issue Visa-branded RMB bank cards within China, nor can it provide services to domestic entities.
